intro: You work two economies at once — dice and cards — and they meet at your Crucible Cards when you are ready to Fire.

seasons.title: Harvest Essence
seasons.subtitle: The Dice Economy
seasons.summary: Each Autumn, Align your Zodiac Die, Spread, and Astral Houses with the Cosmic Age to Harvest Essence. The Gift of the Age and Perfect Matches pay out the most.

seasons.title: Distill Reagents
seasons.subtitle: Essence into Power
seasons.summary: Spend 5 Essence of one Element to Distill a Reagent of that Element. Reagents fuel Attunements and Crucible Formulas when you Fire your Stone.

seasons.title: Craft & Build
seasons.subtitle: The Card Economy
seasons.summary: Spend 3 cards of one suit to craft Coal. Spend 3 cards of one Planet to build an Astral House. Upgrade to a Mansion with 2 more Planet cards plus a Reagent from the supply.

seasons.title: Grow Your Tableau
seasons.subtitle: Spread, Hand & Arcanum
seasons.summary: Your Spread is your visible engine — active Minor Arcana, Stelliums, and Coal crafting. Your Hand is your Siege reserve. Your Arcanum holds up to two Adept Cards.
